reason: dida (dida Datenschmiede GmbH, Berlin) describes itself as building 'tailor-made AI software for process automation'. It offers ML solutions, consulting, operations and research, mostly in natural language processing and computer vision. Its projects include semantic search for public administration, information extraction from customer requests (Felmo) and AI agents for industrial customer service (Schroff), and its blog covers structured outputs with OpenAI and Pydantic as well as FastAPI. Every open development role is an ML role, so the ai variant fits, leading with Hsan's document processing, semantic search and FastAPI deployment work.
